About Mr. Pon Karthikeyan’s design

Your supplied SketchUp model is about 12 ft 9 in wide (including the 9 in side wall), 10 ft high and 6 ft 10 in deep from the wall to the front of the pooja unit. The TV wall has green matte mica panels behind and above the TV, a wooden mica ledge for small decoratives with a warm-white LED strip beneath, and fixed PVC louvers from 7 ft to the ceiling on the TV wall and the side-wall return, with a warm LED wash from the ceiling line. The green TV panel stands 3 in off the wall.

On the left, a tall black tinted glass shutter (left-hinged) has a rounded wooden mica edge. The floating console sits 8 in above the floor with five side-hinged wooden mica shutters, one black glass shutter that lifts upward, and a warm-white glow underneath.

On the right, an open awards niche with a green floral mica background and two wooden mica shelves displays medals, cups and certificates. Below it is a parking bay for a robot floor cleaner, which comes out through the open slot under the console; the side facing the TV is a fixed wooden mica shutter. The tall pooja unit has CNC-carved wooden mica double shutters facing the TV, and a front facing the foyer finished in green grass mat with a stainless-steel CNC-cut scenery panel, beside a 4 in strip with a concealed light; the green matte finish continues onto the wall end. All lighting is concealed LED strip light.

Wood and PVC use your supplied photos. The matte green is a preview shade; send the mica code to match it exactly. The TV, decoratives, trophies, robot shape, wooden shutter hinge sides, pooja interior and the inside of the glass cabinet are illustrative. Reference colours shows every original SketchUp face. Pricing has not been added.
